description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Route53::QueryLoggingConfig. Creates a configuration for DNS query logging, which publishes query logs for a public hosted zone to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the query logging configuration.

Id.description: The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigns to the configuration for DNS query logging.

HostedZoneId.description: The ID of the public hosted zone that Amazon Route 53 logs queries for.

CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the CloudWatch Logs log group in us-east-1 that Amazon Route 53 publishes query logs to.
